t: You're on Charles Street, in Mayfair, in the City of Westminster. Many of the buildings along it are listed by Historic England, and a number have had distinguished residents over the years. Two people were born on this street. Richard Neville, the fourth Baron Braybrooke, was born here in 1820, and he became a British archaeologist. Victor Conyngham, the fifth Marquess Conyngham, was born here in 1883, and he was a peer. So this is a street of grand townhouses, with aristocratic births among its history.
